The '''''Star Runner''''' was a [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and copiloted by the droid [[TC-38]]. It was used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]]'s [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] to escape from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], which was [[Attack on Kashyyyk|assaulted]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] forces. The ''Star Runner'' was subsequently used by them to travel to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in an attempt to stop the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild's]] plan of using the deadly [[trihexalon]] gas to poison the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] capital.

It was equipped with two gunners on the top and bottom, similar to the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. These guns were powerful enough to blast through V-wings in one shot. It had an advanced [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], which had to be repaired during the ship's escape from Kashyyyk.
